work_identified: The Holy Bible in the Earlier and Later Wycliffite Versions, Vol. 2 — Forshall & Madden 1850 critical edition of the 14th-century Middle English Bible
queries_run: Wycliffe Bible Forshall Madden 1850 edition Middle English language

sources_consulted.found: Describes the F&M 1850 edition explicitly as 'Middle English translation of the Latin Vulgate' — the text itself is in Middle English, already English
Confirms F&M 1850 is the first complete printed edition of the 14th-c. Wycliffite Bible; scholarly critical edition collating 170 MSS; text in Middle English

reasoning: The Wycliffite Bible (c.1382–95) is itself a 14th-century Middle English translation of the Latin Vulgate — it IS an English-language text. The F&M 1850 edition is a critical scholarly edition of that Middle English original. Our item is already in English; the first-English-translation claim is ill-posed.
